checked_scope: The finite-fiber lift bounds and the learned/reference encoder comparison under response factorization.
checks: Within a finite fiber, box capacities Rq_m and prescribed mass g define a compact polytope. Threshold sorted fill minimizes linear response and reverse fill maximizes it; all intermediate values occur by convexity.

For 0<g<sum Rq_m, the proportional-capacity feasible vector is strictly interior, allowing pairwise transfers; invariance forces equal responses. At zero/full mass the feasible allocation can be unique without response constancy.

Exact response factorization through phi_star and a common representation intervention g are necessary hypotheses of stability: sup encoder error a bounds response deviation from nu(x,z) by La^t and within learned-fiber oscillation by L(2a)^t. Changing g or allowing arbitrary within-reference-fiber response invalidates that inference.
